product_family: Adzooma is a cloud-based PPC (pay-per-click) campaign management platform optimizing Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and Facebook/Meta campaigns with audit, optimization, and multi-channel reporting features.

certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found across vendor-domain pages or trust documentation.

certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found across vendor-domain pages or trust documentation.

certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found across vendor-domain pages.

certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found across vendor-domain pages.

privacy.ai_training_note: No mention of using customer ad account data, campaign data, or any customer information for AI model training. Platform offers AI-assisted insights and recommendations but no evidence of training on user data.
privacy.data_region: EEA-primary with data controller (ClickTech Solutions Ltd.) in UK; data transfers outside EEA restricted to Privacy Shield Framework or Standard Contractual Clauses

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Not explicitly specified; HTTPS implied by modern web standards but no TLS version, cipher suite, or technical encryption details published.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: No public documentation; standard practice assumed but not disclosed.

security.name: Data retention policy
security.value: Data retained only as long as necessary to complete the task or meet legal obligations; users may request deletion subject to retention requirements.

security.name: Data access controls
security.value: Not detailed; references 'Data Protection Officer' for inquiries but no public security controls documentation.

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure
security.value: No published security page, responsible disclosure policy, or bug bounty program found.

security.name: Third-party audits
security.value: No public evidence of independent security audits or SOC 2 Type 2 attestation.

products.name: Adzooma Core Platform
products.data_scope: Ad account credentials (OAuth for Google, Microsoft, Facebook), campaign structure, spend data, audience data, conversion tracking. Does NOT access or store customer landing pages or customer customer data.
products.notes: Per vendor homepage metrics: $17B+ in cumulative ad spend analysed and 48M+ free performance reports generated (these are analysis/audit totals, not funds managed on customers' behalf). Free tier available; paid tiers for agencies and enterprises.

products.name: PPC Account Audits
products.data_scope: Read-only analysis of connected ad accounts; generates reports without modifying campaigns by default.
products.notes: Automated audit and scoring; requires OAuth integration with ad platforms.

products.name: Multi-channel Reporting
products.data_scope: Aggregates performance data from Google, Microsoft, and Facebook ad accounts into unified dashboards.
products.notes: Real-time reporting; alert system for performance drops or budget overages.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium subscription with monthly recurring billing; free tier includes core audit and reporting, paid tiers ($50 to $300+/month) add advanced optimization, team seats, and custom reporting.
compare.data_residency: EEA primary (UK controller); data controller ClickTech Solutions Ltd. based in Nottingham, UK. Data transfers outside EEA gated by Privacy Shield (now invalid under Schrems II; likely relies on Standard Contractual Clauses but not explicitly stated).

flags: Privacy Shield Framework reference in privacy policy is outdated and legally invalid since Schrems II (July 2020); privacy policy should reference Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or Binding Corporate Rules (BCRs) instead. Recommend immediate policy update.
No dedicated trust center or security page despite handling sensitive ad account data and OAuth credentials for third-party ad platforms.
No SOC 2 Type 2 certification despite being a SaaS data processor handling customer financial and campaign data, notwithstanding the $17B+ in cumulative ad spend the platform reports analysing.
Encryption standards (TLS version, cipher suites, key management) not publicly documented.
No published vulnerability disclosure policy or responsible disclosure program.
No evidence of independent security audits or penetration testing; no public attestation letters.
Data processing agreement (DPA) referenced but not published; unclear if Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) are included for GDPR/non-EEA compliance.
